setup: postfiat-node init --data-dir <keygen> --chain-id postfiat-lane-sepolia-example --validators 6 (only to generate the six validator keys)
committee root computed from the six public keys as FastSwapCommitteeV1::computed_root does (SHA3-384, domain postfiat.fastswap.committee.v1), written into the genesis
postfiat-node init --data-dir validator-0 --node-id validator-0 --genesis-file docs/review/base-sepolia-lock-rehearsal-20261106/genesis.json, with the six keys in place
postfiat-node snapshot-export --data-dir validator-0 --snapshot-dir <snapshot>; snapshot-import --data-dir validator-N --node-id validator-N --snapshot-dir <snapshot> for N = 1..5

postfiat-node topology --chain-id postfiat-lane-sepolia-example --validators 6 --base-port 37650 --rpc-base-port 37750, then the harness bound it to the lane genesis hash and recomputed topology_id f4e180cb9f05a729412031bbe5e53fc51c03ffddf146c8bcd07e46e24571f60126c0f59d4ec37bb68507a1641152fd80 (topology derives its domain from a lane-less genesis)
